shop.name: Big Ideas Little Maker
shop.heroTitle: 3D printed treasures, designed by a 9-year-old maker
shop.about: Every piece is printed one thin layer at a time in my little workshop. Pick your favorites, add them to your list, and send me a message on Instagram to order.
shop.heroNote: thank you for supporting a young maker!
shop.contactNote: Orders are handled by a parent through Instagram messages.

products.name: Flexi Crystal Dragon
products.description: A wiggly dragon with moving joints. It bends, curls and sits on your shoulder. Printed in one piece, no glue!

products.name: Custom Name Keychain
products.description: Your name (up to 10 letters) in two colors. Great for backpacks and lunch boxes.

products.name: Sleepy Cat Planter
products.description: A tiny planter for succulents with a sleepy cat face. Has a drainage hole.

products.name: Pocket Axolotl
products.description: A smiley little axolotl that fits in your pocket. Collect all the colors!
